author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
So, the update has been up for around a week now. Along with the update came some pretty good SG maps. I was wondering which SG maps you guys like the most! And if possible, leave a review on its map page by looking up the map name with (http://avicus.net/maps/(map name)). I added map.pngs for them if you didn't know what they look like, since there's so many.

My favorites are Dry Bone Valley, Zone 85, and Breeze Island.
